official_page_findings.description: The page identifies the July 2026-2027 HOME-HTC application round and a 2026-2027 final QAP.

For 2026, local PHA calculations are not accepted; the page permits service-provider documentation, the HUD Utility Schedule Model, or an SD Housing worksheet request and requires property-specific calculation.
SD Housing directs income-restriction users to HUD User rather than publishing one statewide static LIHTC figure table on the reviewed page.

blocking_conflicts.description: Current-looking QAP, compliance, utility and form links were observed on official pages, but inline resources did not yield exact binary identities and cannot be released.
The visible resource title identifies a final 2026-2027 QAP, but its internal adoption, approval and effective-date evidence requires exact capture and validation.
The compliance manual URL identifies 2025 while the application page is operating a 2026 cycle; supersession and newer notices require reconciliation.
SD Housing routes income restrictions to HUD User and property dates and elections remain necessary; no statewide property figure may be activated.
The 2026 page disallows local PHA calculations and requires one of specified methods plus property-specific evidence and timing; a generic allowance is prohibited.
A current public blank Annual Owner Certification was not located in the reviewed program-management form inventory.
